svg.title: About. I build a feature end to end, then stay to keep it running. Final-year BSc Computer Science student at the University of Pretoria. I work across the full stack with a focus on data: I build the pipeline, the API and the interface for a feature, then take it to production and look after it once real people use it. Comfortable from low-level systems and networking up to production web apps. I care about the unglamorous parts too: tests worked out by hand, migrations that round-trip, deploys that stay up. Away from the keyboard: gym and gaming. Studying: BSc Computer Science University of Pretoria. Graduating: End of 2026 . Based in: Gauteng South Africa. Open to: Internships and graduate roles.
